test_title: PYST 16: SSC MTS - Reasoning (Held on: 18 Oct 2021 Shift 2)
subject: reasoning
question:
Select the option in which the numbers are related in the same way, as the numbers of the following set.

56 ∶ 90 ∶ 132
solution:
The logic followed here is:

**Logic: Multiplication of consecutive numbers**

7 × 8 =** 56**

9 × 10 = **90**

11 × 12 = **132**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f6e98f5cb7b40f81b36fcec9db66f4dde0fe393ee11f7ca8b29046b1c8e6134f.png] 

Similarly,

8 × 9 = **72**

10 × 11 = **110**

12 × 13 = **156**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/fee9f505177795a04621b2d639f78b9ab827ac3d4d803617a42ac65a6b46f657.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is **"72 : 110 : 156".**
